$comment: Ground truth for `pnpm eval`. Each planted defect is something a competent reviewer would flag. Recall is measured against this list; anything an issue cluster reports that is NOT here counts as a candidate false positive and goes to one-time manual adjudication, after which the verdict is cached in eval/adjudications.json.
goal: Find pricing and start a trial

defects.title: Pricing is three clicks from the homepage
defects.notes: Home -> Products -> Plans -> Plan details. No pricing link in primary nav.

defects.title: Primary navigation is icon-only with no accessible names
defects.notes: Anchors contain a glyph span and no text, aria-label, or title.

defects.title: Primary CTA fails contrast against its background
defects.notes: #b9c6d6 on #cfd8e3 — roughly 1.3:1, well under WCAG AA 4.5:1.

defects.title: Trial signup email field has no label
defects.notes: Bare input with a placeholder only. No label, aria-label, or aria-labelledby.

defects.title: Newsletter modal traps focus and has no visible close
defects.notes: Appears on load, no aria-modal, close control is a bare glyph div with no role.

defects.title: Customer logo carousel images have no alt text
defects.notes: Six img elements, all alt="" while conveying meaning (customer names).

defects.title: No security, compliance, or data-handling information anywhere
defects.notes: Absence-of-information finding. Tests whether the persona reports what is missing rather than only what is present.

defects.title: Contact page offers no actual contact route
defects.notes: Says 'get in touch' with no address, phone, form, or email.
